- Unseal media; compute SHA256 on /bundles/manifest_v3.tar.gz -> compare to manifest_v3.sha256 (delivered on separate USB token)
- Verify manifest_v3.tar.gz.sig against Acme root signing cert (we'll exchange cert thumbprints in the drive link)
- Run offline integrity-check tool (redwood-offcheck v2.1) from playbook: activation-playbook-v1.md step 3

We recommend the activation ceremony be witnessed by one Acme engineer and one Redwood operator (remote via video is acceptable) plus the courier sign-off. If the auditor wants a custody chain record, we'll produce the signed handback token.

I've attached the activation playbook (draft) — please flag anything critical. If that works, we can lock the 11/29 09:00-12:00 PT slot for delivery + 14:00-16:00 PT for activation.
